float32_t tolerance
 Tolerance for Jacobi iteration method. This tolerance defines one of the stopping criteria as off_diagonal_norm < initial_frobenius_norm * tolerance.
 
float32_t zeroThrsldFactor
 zeroThrsldFactor * frobenius_norm decides if an element is sufficiently close to zero.

 Maximum Jacobi Iterations

 

Detailed Description

Jacobi EVD Configuration parameters.

The structure is used to hold the configuration parameters for Eigen Value Decomposition
